sections.title: Our *Services*
sections.intro: AVRIX helps organisations find their weaknesses, strengthen their defences and stay compliant as threats and regulations change.

sections.title: Securing every industry, *every day*
sections.intro: Sector-focused security testing and compliance to protect what matters most to your business.

sections.title: Everything your business needs to stay *resilient*
sections.intro: Four disciplines that work together, from finding weaknesses to proving compliance and recovering fast.

sections.title: Aligned to the frameworks *your customers trust*
sections.intro: We help you meet the standards and regulations that UK and European customers, insurers and regulators ask for.

sections.title: Why businesses choose *AVRIX*
sections.intro: Hands-on security expertise with clear, honest reporting that protects revenue and reputation.

items.title: Manual, expert testing
items.text: Skilled testers go beyond automated scans to find the business logic and access control flaws that lead to real breaches.

items.title: Every finding confirmed
items.text: We verify issues before they reach your report, with clear evidence and step-by-step fixes your team can act on.

items.title: Free retesting
items.text: Once you've fixed the issues from a penetration test, we retest them and update your report at no extra cost.

items.title: One accountable team
items.text: Testing, monitoring, compliance and response from one team, with one point of contact and plain-English reporting.

sections.title: How we work, *from scoping to sign‑off*
sections.intro: A clear, five-stage process for every engagement, so you always know what happens next.

items.label: Stage 1: Scoping and authorisation
items.title: Free consultation and written scope
items.text: We understand your goals, agree what's in scope and confirm rules of engagement. Testing never starts without signed authorisation.

items.label: Stage 2: Assessment
items.title: Hands-on testing and gap analysis
items.text: Our specialists test your systems or review your controls against the standards that matter to you.

items.label: Stage 3: Reporting and action plan
items.title: Prioritised findings and walkthrough
items.text: A plain-English summary for leadership, technical detail for your team, and a call to agree priorities.

items.label: Stage 4: Remediation and retesting
items.title: Fixes verified
items.text: We support your team through the fixes, then retest to confirm issues are closed.

items.label: Stage 5: Assurance
items.title: Evidence for customers and auditors
items.text: Retest letters, compliance evidence and board-ready reporting you can share with confidence.

sections.intro: Clear answers on scoping, testing, compliance and response.

sections.title: Ready to build an *unshakeable security posture?*
sections.text: Talk to our security team about testing, monitoring or compliance. We'll scope your needs and give you a clear proposal.
